## What this changes

## How to check it

- [ ] `python build/check.py` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src/scripts build` and `ruff format --check src/scripts build` pass
- [ ] Rebuilt with `python build/build.py` (or `--skip-render` for code and docs only)
- [ ] Before and after images attached for anything visual
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
